jobs.title: Rekrutmen Badan Amil Zakat Nasional (BAZNAS)
jobs.description: Badan Amil Zakat Nasional (BAZNAS) adalah badan resmi dan satu-satunya yang dibentuk oleh pemerintah berdasarkan Keputusan Presiden RI No. 8 Tahun 2001 yang memiliki tugas dan fungsi menghimpun dan menyalurkan zakat, infak, dan sedekah (ZIS) pada tingkat nasional. Berikut ini lowongan kerja Badan Amil Zakat Nasional (BAZNAS). Lahirnya Undang-Undang Nomor 23 Tahun 2011 tentang Pengelolaan Zakat semakin mengukuhkan peran BAZNAS sebagai lembaga yang berwenang melakukan pengelolaan zakat secara nasional. Dalam UU tersebut, BAZNAS dinyatakan sebagai lembaga pemerintah nonstruktural yang bersifat mandiri dan bertanggung jawab kepada Presiden melalui Menteri Agama. Dalam mengelola zakat, BAZNAS menerapkan prinsip 3A, yakni Aman Syari, Aman Regulasi, dan Aman NKRI. Aman Syari artinya pengelolaan zakat yang dilaksanakan BAZNAS harus selaras dengan koridor hukum syari. Pengelolaan zakat harus selaras dan tidak boleh bertentangan dengan sumber hukum Islam, Al-Quran dan Sunnah. Aman Regulasi artinya bahwa pengelolaan zakat harus memperhatikan rambu-rambu peraturan hukum dan perundangan. jobs.title: Research Scientist, Synthetic Organic Chemistry
jobs.description: About us We're reverse-engineering the origin of life — one of the great unsolved problems in science, and one we think AI finally makes tractable. Understanding this transition, from geochemistry to biochemistry, is what will let us orchestrate molecular networks and build systems that are more capable, adaptive, and efficient. If we succeed, the applications are vast: catalysis, green synthesis, ab initio synthetic biology, programmable matter. Understanding and harnessing these processes could let ten billion of us thrive on this planet — and let life keep evolving beyond it. We're a small, diverse team of AI engineers, computational scientists, and bench scientists. We hold ourselves to the rigor of a research institute, but we ship like an engineering firm. Global team, HQs in Cambridge, MA and London, UK. The role We're looking for a chemist who combines organic synthesis with strong analytical expertise. You'll synthesise biological molecules — including peptides, nucleic acid derivatives, and modified building blocks — and develop methods to understand how they behave in chemical and biochemical reactions. Analytical method development is a central part of the role. You'll use chromatography and mass spectrometry to identify products, quantify reaction progress, and resolve complex mixtures. Working closely with our enzymologists and computational scientists, you'll help decide what to make, how to measure it, and what the results tell us about the underlying chemistry. What you'll do Design and execute syntheses of biological molecules and their derivatives, optimising reaction conditions and purification strategies. Develop and troubleshoot LC-MS/MS methods, particularly triple-quadrupole methods for targeted quantification of substrates and products. Apply Orbitrap-based proteomics workflows to characterise peptides, proteins, and their modifications. Establish compound identity and purity using chromatography, NMR, and mass spectrometry. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineering Consultant
jobs.description: Als Senior Data Engineering Consultant bij BigData Republic adviseer je toonaangevende organisaties in Nederland over complexe data-vraagstukken. Je combineert hands-on engineering met een adviserende rol: je schrijft productie-klare code, denkt mee over strategische bedrijfsbeslissingen en begeleidt collega’s om naar een hoger niveau te groeien. Je hebt je carrière opgebouwd rond het ontwerpen en bouwen van datasystemen. Je werkt graag inhoudelijk mee, maar verliest kwaliteit, schaalbaarheid en duurzaamheid nooit uit het oog. Je bent een ervaren Data Engineer die vaak moeilijk in één functie te vatten is, omdat je op meerdere niveaus impact maakt. En je bent toe aan een nieuwe uitdaging. Bij BigData Republic ontwikkelen we data-applicaties, bouwen we data-platformen, creëren we voorspellende modellen en ontwerpen we robuuste data-infrastructuren. We werken vanuit een software-engineering mindset, met focus op technische hoogstaande kwaliteit. Kennisdeling en thought leadership vormen de kern van onze cultuur. Elke vrijdag organiseren we kennissessies op kantoor, we schrijven blogs, organiseren meetups en bezoeken en spreken op conferenties. Je werkt aan complexe projecten voor grote klanten in uiteenlopende sectoren, terwijl je onderdeel bent van een klein, informeel en hecht team van vakgenoten dat elkaar uitdaagt en inspireert. Bij BigData Republic ben je de expert in de kamer én leer je elke dag van je collega’s. En vooral: je kunt hier jezelf zijn. In de praktijk besteed je ongeveer 90% van je tijd aan klantprojecten. De overige tijd is expliciet gereserveerd voor eigen initiatieven: een pet project, innovatie of een idee dat je samen met collega’s wilt uitwerken. Je past goed bij deze rol als je ervaring hebt met (een deel van) onderstaande tooling en concepten: Je hebt een sterke basis in; Python Cloud (AWS, GCP of Azure) Data pipelines bouwen en ouderhouden (ELT/ ETL) Data warehousing (Databricks, Snowflake of BigQuery) Orchestratie (Airflow, Dagster) Terraf

jobs.description: Counterpart: Value-based care, at the point of care. At Counterpart Health, we are transforming healthcare and improving patient care with our innovative primary care tool, Counterpart Assistant. By supporting Primary Care Physicians (PCPs), we are able to deliver improved outcomes to our patients at a lower cost through early diagnosis and longitudinal care management of chronic conditions. We are hiring an Implementation Manager on the Counterpart Assistant team. In this role, you will lead the customer-facing work of bringing new provider practices and TINs from late-stage prospects through successful launch on Counterpart Assistant. You will partner closely with account management to hand off new customers, own the customer relationship through implementation, and drive each launch to completion on time and at quality. You will independently lead multiple concurrent implementations and the cross-functional work that makes each launch happen. Partnering with account management, support, product, and engineering internally and with providers, office managers, and clinical leads on the customer side: you will drive accountability across every stakeholder and deliver results through influence. Beyond running individual launches, you will help shape the implementation playbook itself — identifying what slows launches down, proposing changes, and driving improvements that reduce time-to-launch and lift customer satisfaction. Strong project management fundamentals, clear customer communication, working knowledge of clinical data, and technical fluency will let you keep complex, multi-stakeholder launches on track. As an Implementation Manager, you will: Own the customer relationship through implementation: you are the primary point of contact for the customer's technical implementation from project kickoff to post go live steady state. Lead end-to-end project plans for multiple concurrent, multi-step implementations, keeping internal and customer teams aligned on scope

jobs.title: Manager, Business Analytics & Insights
jobs.description: Who are we and why should you join us? BetterHelp is on a mission to remove the traditional barriers to therapy and make mental health care more accessible to everyone. Founded in 2013, we are now the world’s largest online therapy service, providing affordable and convenient therapy across the globe. Our network of over 30,000 licensed therapists has helped millions of people take ownership of their mental health and change their lives forever. And we’re not stopping there – as the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution. As the Manager of Business Analysis & Insights at BetterHelp, you’ll join a diverse team of licensed clinicians, engineers, product pros, creatives, marketers, and business leaders who share a passion for expanding access to therapy. And as a mental health company, we take employee mental health just as seriously as we do our mission. We deeply invest in our team’s well-being and professional development, because we know that business and individual growth go hand-in-hand. At BetterHelp, you’ll carve your own path, make an immediate impact, and be challenged every day – with a supportive community behind you the whole way. What are we looking for? We are seeking an experienced Manager, Business Analysis & Insights to serve as a strategic thought partner to the CFO and executive leadership team across BetterHelp. This role is best suited for someone who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, proactively identifying opportunities, and operating with a high degree of ownership in a fast-paced environment. We’re looking for someone with a strong passion for turning data into compelling narratives and a demonstrated ability to influence outcomes through cross-functional collaboration. Success in this role requires balancing analytical depth with speed. The ideal candidate knows when to dive deep and when to synthesize quickly, delivering insights that help leaders make better decisions

Dann übernimmst du bei uns in Geiselhöring die Leitung der gesamten IT der TransRegina-Gruppe. Dazu gehören Server und Netzwerke, Lager-IT und Zeiterfassung genauso wie die Systeme, mit denen wir unsere Spedition steuern. Besonders spannend wird es dort, wo Telematik und Disposition zusammenkommen: Hier entscheidet gute IT direkt darüber, wie effizient unsere LKW unterwegs sind. Du berichtest direkt an die Geschäftsleitung, und gute Ideen setzt du bei uns schnell um. Du stellst den elektronischen Datenaustausch mit unseren Kunden sicher und bindest neue Kunden technisch an. Du treibst die Digitalisierung unserer Abläufe voran, von papierlosen Prozessen bis zum praxisnahen Einsatz von KI-Tools. Strategie & Infrastruktur Du entwickelst unsere IT-Strategie, verantwortest das IT-Budget und planst Investitionen gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsleitung. jobs.title: Pflichtpraktikum Produktentwicklung (all genders)
jobs.description: Du willst nicht nur zuschauen, sondern verstehen, wie aus einer Idee ein Produkt wird, das Kund:innen wirklich nachkaufen? Die MainTea GmbH ist ein Food-Startup aus Frankfurt am Main mit rund 30 Mitarbeitenden und Teil der MainTea-Gruppe. Zur Gruppe gehören mehrere Marken: Besser im Glas (D2C), PRO2BE , Bubble Pop und Bubble Chill , jeweils im Lebensmitteleinzelhandel. Die Produktentwicklung arbeitet für alle diese Marken, und genau dort bist du in deinem Pflichtpraktikum fest im Team: Du verkostest, recherchierst Trends, stimmst dich mit Herstellern und Lieferanten ab und begleitest neue Produkte von der ersten Idee bis ins Regal. Wenn du Food liebst und in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen mit flachen Hierarchien echte Verantwortung übernehmen willst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung, ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung. Deine Aufgaben Produktentwicklung über alle Marken: Du arbeitest aktiv an Neuentwicklungen und Sortimentserweiterungen für Besser im Glas und PRO2BE, von Tee- und Gewürzmischungen über Protein-Produkte bis zu Getränken. Verkostung & Produkttests: Du planst und organisierst strukturierte Verkostungen, wertest Geschmack, Aroma, Textur und Optik aus und lieferst Feedback, das direkt in die Weiterentwicklung einfließt. Trendrecherche & Marktbeobachtung: Du behältst Food- und Getränketrends im Blick, beobachtest Wettbewerber im Onlinehandel und im Supermarkt und bringst eigene Ideen für neue Sorten und Konzepte ein. Rezeptur-Support: Du hilfst bei der Vorbereitung, Durchführung und Dokumentation von Produktentwicklungen und pflegst Rezepturen und Produktdaten. Lieferanten & Muster: Du fragst Rohstoffe, Muster und Angebote bei Herstellern und Co-Packern an, vergleichst sie und behältst den Überblick über laufende Anfragen. Produktdaten & Kennzeichnung: Du unterstützt beim Erstellen von Spezifikationen, Zutatenlisten und Etikettentexten und arbeitest dabei eng mit Qualitätsmanagement und Grafik zusammen. Besorgungen & Testlogistik: Du besorgst Testzuta

Chez Decathlon, nous croyons au pouvoir du sport pour unir et inspirer. Notre mission : rendre le sport accessible au plus grand nombre, partout dans le monde. Pour y parvenir, la data est au cœur de notre stratégie, guidant chaque décision, de la conception du produit à l expérience client. Notre défi ? La rendre gouvernée, sûre et exploitable. Tu joueras un rôle pivot dans la définition, le déploiement et l’amélioration continue des standards de gouvernance, avec un focus sur les sujets de Data Knowledge et/ou Data Quality. jobs.description: Build a Safer World. TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure. As a Global Investigator on the triage team, you will be the first line of operational defense in a fast-moving crypto disruption pipeline. You will process inbound complaint data, validate outputs from our artificial-intelligence (AI) investigation platform, and route cases into the investigative pipelines that result in frozen scam proceeds and seized assets. You will hold the disposition pen: your call is what turns a complaint into a freeze, a takedown, a recovery handoff, a legal-process draft, a victim notification, or a close. The impact you will have: Validate and route hundreds of complaint dispositions per week, feeding a live asset-recovery pipeline. Catch the AI errors that matter, such as false positives, merged syndicates, and misclassified scam patterns, before they propagate downstream. Enrich complaint selectors using a stack of more than forty commercial data-source integrations. Own clean shift handoffs so the around-the-clock operation never drops a lead, providing EMEA-hours coverage that keeps the queue moving while colleagues in other regions are offline. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables. Today, engineering at Prior Labs is a small, very senior team. We plan to grow it substantially over the next 18 months, and your job is to build and run that organization. jobs.description: ISOPLUS – part of Viessmann Generations Group Location: Germany | Regular travel across Europe Lead the transformation of ISOPLUS – part of the Viessmann Generations Group portfolio As Head of Transformation / PMO at ISOPLUS, you will lead the transformation agenda of one of Viessmann Generations Group’s largest portfolio companies across its decentralised European organisation. Reporting directly to the CEO of ISOPLUS, you will translate strategic priorities into execution and drive key initiatives across the Group. With direct CEO reporting, exposure to the VGG ecosystem and strong development opportunities within ISOPLUS, this role offers an attractive step-up for someone looking to move from advising transformation to driving it from within. ISOPLUS & Viessmann Generations Group ISOPLUS is a leading European provider of pre-insulated piping systems for district heating and sustainable energy infrastructure, with more than 1,500 team members, nine production sites and a presence across 30+ countries. The Labs purpose is to test new AI capabilities, identify what works, how they'd improve delivery, and then build assets to support teams and clients. jobs.description: Zie jij snel welke data nodig is om een businessvraag te beantwoorden? Als Data Analist binnen het Data & AI Office analyseer je data, vertaal je vraagstukken uit de business naar concrete inzichten en help je collega’s om die inzichten te gebruiken voor betere beslissingen. Ook onderzoek je waar AI waarde kan toevoegen en werk je mee aan praktische toepassingen die de manier van werken verbeteren. Je bent de schakel tussen de business en de specialisten binnen Data & AI. Daarmee zorg je ervoor dat goede ideeën niet blijven hangen in analyses of experimenten, maar leiden tot oplossingen die medewerkers daadwerkelijk gebruiken en die waarde opleveren voor onze leden. Wie ben jij Jij bent analytisch sterk en oprecht nieuwsgierig naar wat er binnen de business speelt. Je neemt geen genoegen met de eerste vraag, maar onderzoekt welk probleem er werkelijk moet worden opgelost en welke informatie nodig is om een goede beslissing te nemen. Je kunt schakelen tussen verschillende werelden. Je begrijpt de taal van de business, werkt zelf ook graag met data en kan goed samenwerken met technische dataspecialisten. Je hoeft niet zelf ieder model of datapipeline te bouwen, maar je begrijpt voldoende van data en AI om mogelijkheden te herkennen, inhoudelijke vragen te stellen en resultaten kritisch te beoordelen. Geen koffie halen of papierwerk, jij duikt samen met onze veiligheidsadviseur in de praktijk van veiligheid op de bouwplaats. Of het nu gaat om het uitvoeren van inspecties of meedenken over veiligheidstrainingen: jij maakt impact. Dit wordt jouw stage Als stagiair bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Amsterdam ga je aan de slag op ons kantoor of op één van onze projecten. Tijdens je stage word je goed begeleid door één van onze collega’s en krijg je de ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen! Je geeft zelf richting aan de werkzaamheden door verantwoordelijkheid te laten zien. Jij bepaalt, samen met je begeleider hoe jouw stageperiode eruit komt te zien. Jouw inzet en ideeën zijn bepalend voor het succes van je stage! Dit ga je doen Mee op pad om veiligheidsinspecties uit te voeren. jobs.description: Direction de Projets – Ingénierie, Construction & Infrastructures Critiques 1. Présentation du poste Intitulé : Directeur de Projet Data Center (Data Center Project Director) Rattachement hiérarchique : Directeur des Opérations / Directeur de Programme / Direction Générale Périmètre : France et International Secteur : Data Centers – Infrastructures critiques – Construction – Ingénierie 2. Mission principale Le Directeur de Projet Data Center assure le pilotage stratégique, technique, opérationnel et financier de projets complexes de conception, de construction, d'extension ou de transformation de Data Centers. Il garantit la bonne exécution des projets dans le respect des engagements contractuels, des budgets, des délais, des exigences de qualité, de sécurité, de performance énergétique et de disponibilité des infrastructures. Il intervient sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie des projets, depuis les études de faisabilité jusqu'à la réception des installations, leur mise en service et leur transfert aux équipes d'exploitation. Véritable chef d'orchestre, il coordonne les différentes parties prenantes et assure l'interface entre la maîtrise d'ouvrage, la maîtrise d'œuvre, les bureaux d'études, les entreprises de construction, les fournisseurs et les exploitants. 3. Responsabilités principales A. Direction et pilotage stratégique des projets Définir la stratégie globale d'exécution et les objectifs du projet. Piloter des projets de Data Centers neufs (Greenfield), d'extension ou de rénovation (Brownfield). Superviser toutes les phases du projet, de la faisabilité à la livraison. Définir les jalons, les livrables et les indicateurs de performance. Mettre en place la gouvernance et les instances de décision. Arbitrer les choix techniques, économiques et organisationnels. jobs.title: Event Specialist
jobs.description: Primary Tasks Lead the conceptualization, planning, and execution of events, from pre-production to post-event evaluation. Create and manage event timelines, checklists, and budgets to ensure smooth and cost-efficient execution. Oversee venue selection, supplier coordination, and vendor negotiations, ensuring quality and adherence to timelines. Manage permits, logistics, security, and technical requirements for each event. Coordinate with internal teams (Production, Creative, Marketing, PR, Finance) to ensure all deliverables are aligned. Work in tandem with the Executive Producer to align production coverage and live multimedia needs. Coordinate with the Marketing and Accounts Teams for partner requirements, branding placements, and deliverables. Maintain clear communication with sponsors, suppliers, and stakeholders before, during, and after each event. Secondary Tasks (During Lean Periods) Assist the marketing team in campaign coordination, partnership fulfillment, and client servicing. Support in crafting event proposals, sponsorship decks, and presentations for potential partners. Help manage marketing collaterals, promotional materials, and PR coordination. Conduct post-event partner evaluations and recommend ways to strengthen partnerships.
